# Chapter 9: Nancy

The grocery store was unremarkable, the kind of chain store that could have been anywhere in America, stocked with the same products and lit with the same fluorescent lights. Bob was twenty-four years old, home from the Navy for a brief leave, wandering the aisles on a Tuesday afternoon because he had nothing better to do and the air conditioning was better than the apartment he was staying in.
